title: AI for traditional Indian industries
summary: Find the Indian traditional industry where AI is the lowest-hanging fruit, then the single solution in it with the highest chance of success for a small team within 12 months.
scope: Open: any traditional Indian industry. The industry scan chooses where to look.
geography: India, starting with Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities
buyer: Businesses or institutions in the chosen industry (decided by research)
constraints: Small founding team, no hardware manufacturing
Must sell in under 6 months per customer
Interfaces in English, Hindi and at least one regional language
goal: One industry and one idea with evidence of willingness to pay and a test that can run in 4 weeks
